title: India Inducts 3rd Nuclear Ballistic Submarine 'INS Aridaman' — Maintains 3 SSBNs at Sea
summary: India inducts INS Aridaman (7,000-tonne Arihant-class SSBN), becoming one of few nations maintaining 3 operational nuclear submarines at sea.

blocks.title: 📰 4. 🌐 NATIONAL, STATE & INTERNATIONAL NEWS
blocks.text: 🪝 India Inducts 3rd Nuclear Ballistic Submarine 'INS Aridaman' — Maintains 3 SSBNs at Sea. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: India inducted **INS Aridaman**, its 3rd nuclear-powered ballistic missile submarine (SSBN) built under the Advanced Technology Vessel (ATV) project at Visakhapatnam, after INS Arihant (2016) and INS Arighat (2024).
**Armament**: 8 vertical launch tubes carrying K-15 (700 km) and K-4 (3,500 km) SLBMs.
**4th SSBN**: 'Arisudan' under construction, expected by 2027. Reinforces India's nuclear triad.
